title: Buprofezin as a potent corrosion inhibitor for carbon steel in 1 M HCl solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50652-50665
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05962C, Paper

Sally A. Abu Al-Khair, Rabab M. Abou-Shahba, Walaa A. Hussein, Ahmed A. El-Hossiany, Abd El-Aziz S. Fouda
Buprofezin was utilized to inhibit carbon steel (CS) corrosion in 1 M HCl using electrochemical analysis (potentiodynamic polarization, or PDP), chemical analysis (mass loss, or ML), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) testing.
